name: double_boost

warns.msg: Boost applied 5×; optimal for a 8-state search space is 2×.
warns.plain: After the optimal boost count (2×) the marked item's probability reverses. You have applied Boost 5 times — the target is losing probability.

qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator

# Generated by QuantumCanvas  —  Quantum Search — Grover-like Pattern
# Pattern: grover_like

qc = QuantumCircuit(3, 3)

# INITIALIZE — all qubits start in |0⟩ (Qiskit default, no gates needed)

# SHAKE Q1, Q2, Q3 — Hadamard: equal superposition
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)

# MARK Q3 — computational basis oracle
# Marks the |1⟩ state of [Q3]
# using X·MCZ·X pattern (phase -1 on target basis state only)
qc.x(0)
qc.x(1)
qc.h(2)
qc.ccx(0, 1, 2)
qc.h(2)
qc.x(0)
qc.x(1)

# BOOST — Grover diffusion: 2|ψ⟩⟨ψ| - I on [Q1, Q2, Q3]
# Step 1: H on all — rotate to computational basis
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)

# Step 2: X on all — shift |0...0⟩ to |1...1⟩
qc.x(0)
qc.x(1)
qc.x(2)

# Step 3: multi-controlled phase flip on |1...1⟩
qc.h(2)
qc.ccx(0, 1, 2)
qc.h(2)

# Step 4: X on all — undo shift
qc.x(0)
qc.x(1)
qc.x(2)

# Step 5: H on all — rotate back
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)

# MEASURE Q1 — measure into classical bits
qc.measure(0, 0)

# ── Run on Aer simulator ──────────────────────────────────────
simulator = AerSimulator()
compiled  = transpile(qc, simulator)
job       = simulator.run(compiled, shots=1000)
result    = job.result()
counts    = result.get_counts()

print("Circuit:")
print(qc.draw(output="text"))

print("\nMeasurement counts (1000 shots):")
for state, count in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
    print(f"  |{state}⟩: {count} ({count/10:.1f}%)")
